summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: 800VDC AI Datacenter Ecosystem ETF is an actively managed exchange-traded fund that seeks investment exposure to companies most directly linked to the 800VDC datacenter power ecosystem. The fund focuses on companies involved in power generation, electrical infrastructure, power distribution, data center systems, and related technologies supporting the transition to 800VDC power architectures for next-generation AI data centers.
